other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must belong to Antyodaya, BPL, or Annapurna families
Applicant must have a ration card
benefits_summary: Antyodaya families receive 35 kg of wheat per family; other eligible families receive 5 kg per month at subsidized rates of ₹1 or ₹2 per kg.
